title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: wellness-reimbursement proposed amount
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, a wellness-reimbursement waiver's proposed amount equals the tier's wellness-reimbursement percentage of the enrolled employee's own club membership monthly dues rate — obtained by reading that membership's own most recent recurring-dues charge on file, which reflects its tier's current rate — rounded to 2 decimal places. This proposed amount is calculated before any of the further limits on a wellness-reimbursement waiver are applied.

Worked example (hypothetical): if a tier's wellness-reimbursement percentage were 20 percent and the employee's own club membership monthly dues rate were $28.00, the proposed amount would be 20 percent of $28.00, which is $5.60.
